Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team at Catalyst loved the latency numbers and the model-switch routing demo. We're kicking off Cohort 7 of the Catalyst Sprint next month and wanted to discuss pilot credits + a short extension for a couple of our portfolio startups. Two asks:

1) Eligibility — can you confirm what the accelerator credit criteria look like for a cohort program (company stage, MRR cap, acceptable use, security checklist)?
2) Procurement path — for our larger startups we need a simple PO + SOW flow (procurement@catalyst.ai) and an option to sign a short pilot SOW. Is Redwood able to accept a Catalyst PO or do we need DocuSign directly?

Example use case: Beacon Labs (seed, 8 employees) is requesting a 6-month pilot with an anticipated 40M token/month peak during demo week. They'd like a 3-month trial extension while we finalize the PO.

Can you send a one-pager on what you typically offer for accelerator cohorts and any intake form we should have startups fill out?

Best,

Hi Ava — great to hear from you and thrilled Catalyst liked the demo.

Short answers up front:
- Eligibility: typically seed → Series A early-stage startups (pre-prod ok), <$5M ARR preferred for the standard accelerator package. We require a basic security questionnaire and an allowed-use confirmation.
- Credits: we can offer cohort-level allocations plus per-startup top-ups. For Beacon Labs specifically, we can provision an interim 3-month trial extension and a conditional top-up while procurement completes paperwork.
- Procurement: we accept Catalyst POs for pilot deals under $25k; above that we need an SOW + DocuSign signature. PO routing is fine — procurement@redwood.com is our billing intake.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please have Beacon fill our intake spreadsheet (I can share a short Google Sheet).
2) Send any PO template from your procurement team; we can return a signed SOW if the amount exceeds PO limits.
3) I'll loop in Marissa for a final sign-off for credits > $10k.

Tentative offer: interim extension (3 months) + up to $10k in credits for Beacon Labs pending intake + security questionnaire. If Beacon needs >$10k, we'll handle as a cohort top-up and route to Marissa for approval.

Attachments I can send: sample accelerator SOW, intake sheet. Do you prefer a quick 20-min call tomorrow to walk through the intake?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
